answer: Pearl-vertex oasis escrow: each identity claims a vertex in the oasis graph and locks a 70-credit pearl, backed by a sponsor staking 70. Peers may dispute a vertex on shared-funding proof in 3 epochs; proven fakes burn the pearl and slash the sponsor 70; oasis star clusters get flagged. Fees rise per head: the k-th vouch costs 25+5(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 2,522,500 plus 70,000 locked for 40,000. Honest agents pay 25 once and reclaim the pearl.
